name: ^computerInput\.extend$
reason: zod builds the extended object schema; the twin checks the added sandbox property and passes the schema on unchanged.

name: ^onUsage$
reason: A callback the caller hands in to record usage elsewhere; the twin checks the parsed usage it passes.

name: ^session\.runCommand$
reason: Runs the usage probe in the provider sandbox: the sandbox decides stdout and exit code, outside the runtime.

name: ^new Bash$
reason: Constructs the just-bash interpreter library; the twin checks the options it is built with.

name: ^bash \.exec$
reason: The just-bash library runs the script on its in-memory disk; its output is not runtime logic.

name: ^fs\.mkdir$
reason: The just-bash in-memory filesystem creates the directory; the twin checks the path and options.

name: MicrovmWebSocketProxy
reason: The receiver of its own methods: the twin reads its private fields from the snapshot and states each change with setState.

name: ^server\.stop$
reason: Bun stops its own listening server; the twin only starts it without awaiting, as the code does.

name: ^socket\.data\.upstream\?\.close$
reason: The WebSocket client closes the upstream bridge connection; the code and reason are checked.

name: ^executor\.jobLogs$
reason: Reads a background job's log tail from the sandbox provider; the provider decides it, the twin checks the job id, namespace and limit.
